story: IDS-2 (UNSW-NB15 random_3way): name the winner config (weight vector x memory mode) that IDS-7 (n=100) flies.
registered: 2026-10-09 ~17:40 EDT, BEFORE any IDSXD-unswr-qsr-abi13 or SP100-unswr-qsr-abi13 metric was read (72/94 QSR reruns done, results unread by design)
registered_by: Luiz 09/10: '(a) falling back to (b); best EVERYWHERE'; AMENDED same day before any result was read: (a) is THREE metrics — best F1, best FPR (at F1>=93), best Acc — and if they come from different configs, Luiz decides
why: On UNSW-random every QUAD arm sits on the val_cal FP floor (93.41-93.49 F1 / FPR 1.12), so val_cal cannot rank arms. The criterion looks for each run's best operating point ANYWHERE it produced one, on each of F1, FPR and Acc.

arms.definition: 18 arms = 9 weight vectors {B05-AC,B05-CE,B10-AC,B10-CE,B15-AC,B15-CE,B34-CTRL,CE20,Wb-CTRL} x memory mode {QUAD, QSR}
arms.QUAD: IDSXD-unswr-quad-64b-<arm>-r<seed>; for B34-CTRL use the -immfix rerun where one exists (r20401-04, IDS-17: pre-fix rows are 34/8 immigrant hybrids), else the original
arms.QSR: IDSXD-unswr-qsr-64b-<arm>-r<seed>-abi13 ONLY (pre-ABI-13 QSR rows are VOID, IDS-16)
arms.SP100: SP100-unswr-quad-64bWb vs SP100-unswr-qsr-64bWb-abi13 are reported alongside (memory-mode contrast at Wb, larger n) but do NOT enter the arm ranking

metric_source: held-out TEST only: validation_summaries.threshold_metadata, validation_point='final'. NEVER iterations.best_f1, never k-fold.
fallback_b: Applied PER METRIC: if that metric's winner does not beat Wb-CTRL QUAD's mean by at least ONE pooled seed-SD of that metric's per-run scores (pooled over all 18 arms), that metric's winner is Wb-CTRL QUAD (incumbent production control, cheapest).
report_alongside: val_cal GA best_f1 and best_fitness means (the usual table)
for every run, the location (phase / genome type / mode) of each of its three best cells
caveats: Per-run best-of-70 on TEST is selection on the test partition: the numbers are optimistic ('best found') and are NEVER reported as an arm's performance; the arm RANKING is fair because every run gets the same 70 cells. The n=100 IDS-7 cohort is the confirmatory measurement.
Cross-era: QUAD half ran 15-30/09 (worker ABI 12-14), QSR half Oct (ABI 13/14).
n=3 per arm (B34-CTRL n=5): a direction, not a significance claim.
applied_by: IDS-2 completion watcher (session cron) -> ids-security readout; flows created only on Luiz's go.

criterion_a.cells: EVERY cell a run produced: both phases (Grid Search, GA Neurons) x all 5 genome types (best_f1, best_fpr, best_acc, best_ce, best_fitness) x all 7 threshold modes (train_cal, fixed_05, platt, beta, empirical, empirical_cumulative, val_cal) = up to 70 cells, held-out TEST.

per_run_scores.F1: MAX F1 over all cells (tie -> lower FPR)
per_run_scores.FPR: MIN FPR over cells with F1 >= 93.0 (tie -> higher F1); a run with no such cell scores FPR = 100 (reported)
per_run_scores.Acc: MAX Acc over all cells (tie -> lower FPR)

criterion_a.f1_floor_why: FPR metric only. Fixed before results: ~0.4-0.5 pp under the saturated QUAD val_cal band (93.41-93.49), so a low-FPR point cannot trade F1 away for a trivial FPR.
criterion_a.arm_score: per metric, MEAN of per-run scores over the arm's seeds (per-run first, so arms with more seeds gain no best-of-N advantage); report mean +/- SD and n.
criterion_a.metric_winner: per metric, the arm with the best mean (highest F1, lowest FPR, highest Acc).

decision: If the three metric winners (after fallback b) are the SAME arm -> that arm is the IDS-2 winner and IDS-7's config. If they DIFFER -> NO automatic winner: report the three winners side by side (with each one's other two metrics) and escalate to Luiz to decide ('we will need to talk').
